requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: small CREFANS virtual bean currency package icon for the 10-bean option. Reference image is STYLE AND BEAN IDENTITY only: preserve its smooth rounded jade/emerald-green kidney-bean tokens, creamy curved inlaid bean-shaped mark, soft satin 3D material, friendly toy-like proportions and gentle studio lighting. Create a small loose scattering of EXACTLY FIVE chunky beans lying on an implied flat surface, each independently rotated, arranged naturally with clear gaps and at most minor overlap. No container and NO sticks or skewers. Not a mound, not stacked, not floating. The illustration is a package symbol; quantity label is supplied separately by the UI.
